scope: Official hardware behavior evidence for Classic UI parity

sources.title: BOSS RC-505mkII Loop Station product page

claims.claim: Owner's Manual p. 8 numbers the Play Screen variations as MEMORY NUMBER, TRACK STATUS, LOOP TRACKS, LOOP STATUS, LOOP LEVEL, INPUT FX, TRACK FX.
The manual says left/right arrows switch variations but does not establish forward direction or wrap behavior.
MIXER has three documented pages; ENTER from Play opens it, arrows switch pages, knob turn changes level, and input knob push mutes.
MENU opens system settings/USB/MIDI; LOOP opens memory editing. The manual lists MENU categories on p. 17 and LOOP edit categories on p. 13.
EXIT returns to the previous screen; repeated EXIT returns to Play in documented MENU and LOOP-edit procedures, but all origin-specific return edges are not defined.
Knob push is used to select/enter in documented MENU/LOOP procedures and some parameters require push-to-edit; no universal encoder-press action is documented.
Track-button lamp indicates phrase existence; current-track identity is a separate display marker.
Default REC red, PLAY green, DUB yellow per Owner's Manual p. 5 (amber in Parameter Guide v1.3 p. 33), STOP off; track-button colors are configurable.
AUTO REC causes rapid blinking before detected input starts recording; blink color is not specified.
claims.unknown_detail: Standby blink color and exact cadence.

claims.claim: Quantize can align recording completion to a measure, but the guide does not specify a distinct LED color or pattern while waiting for the completion point.
UNDO/REDO secondary assignments are FX=MARK CLEAR, TRACK=MARK SET, STOP=MARK BACK, REC/PLAY=UNDO/REDO; green means undo available, red redo available, off neither.
There are four banks A-D with four FX slots A-D per bank; each slot is assigned an Input FX or Track FX type and associated settings for the selected bank/memory.
FX slot red=on, pink=current operable/editable effect while on, off=off; selected bank blue in bank selection. Pink is not explicitly documented as meaning the edit screen is open.
Input FX and Track FX A-D switches may be configured as TOGGLE or MOMENT; TOGGLE changes on/off each press, while MOMENT is on only while the button is pressed.
The official manual says hold EDIT with a slot to edit and hold EDIT to enter bank selection, but gives no duration.
Parameter Guide v1.3 lists STATUS, LOOP POSITION, and LEVEL modes and names several phrase states and indication concepts; text extraction does not preserve the exact pictogram-to-state mapping.
claims.unknown_detail: Exact LED pattern for each mode/state.

ui_decisions.decision: Right arrow advances Play Screen variations and wraps after TRACK FX.
ui_decisions.hardware_evidence: Official direction and wrap are unspecified.

ui_decisions.decision: Use a 1500 ms long-press threshold for the FX EDIT action.
Clear a track after STOP is held for at least 2000 ms.
ui_decisions.hardware_evidence: Owner's Manual p. 5 says hold STOP for 2 seconds.

validation.note: Software behavior and local WASAPI control/ACK evidence are recorded in validation.json and local-native-smoke.json. This does not certify full physical-hardware parity.
